notes.title: Annoucement | Soup, Games, and Agriculture | Part 2
notes.content:
Part Two: Soup & Games
I'm excited to announce this insane update coming to Kollectomaniac!
This update is scheduled to launch in October 2025.

This update will finally implement the cauldron, a feature that has been hinted at for a while now. 
Using items you Kollect, you can unlock the gate in the grove to cook up some tasty soups!
Walker's will, of course, come to you requesting their favorite soups in exchange for items such as:
Potions, Shop Tokens, Game Cartridges, and more! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/29cc322fd7972300018838f1abd60e5d749ea6bb.png"]Some of these items will assist you in buying and selling, and some items will introduce a fun way to end each day!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/466086b9874ca4813d85ada6a0c26f15365f810e.png"]By making soup, you can obtain the game console and four game cartridges! Interacting with the nearby bench will allow you to end the day by playing video games!  I'm here to share some screenshots and info about each game!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/4439bc8045f447e89afafb2c9588d90b755e38da.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/9e499a1cf996149ffe8e2fd44c7acdc2ed026967.png"]A game based on "The Binding of Isaac" follows Goobert as you try to escape Noise.
You collect items, battle bosses, and kill enemies!
All with an original soundtrack by Hobocatt & voice acting by The Last Seahorse
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/541b3a3dc07522eb34b43ce5d04332f0f64cf017.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/05b540e598362dc0215ea43252f40fe369bacf08.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/9e86d42dfdf45325eb32703733274a3030686d11.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/2dece8a5b741253126dc5f5b9fe206c2c46b1279.png"]A rogue-like where you play breakout, fight pong bosses, and buy & collect items to win!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/45078d6e1ce6bd5cd2001ec10c22a73a2ab9835a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/8901e3002fbcd0acb520af3d0c2657d870445c83.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/b3eae264bcdcaadffde15ebfc71b71f90f1ac4ab.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/92ecde975b1381ecd50c850854774460f9dcba1d.png"]A WarioWare-style game where you try to reach a high score by completing minigames faster and faster! Play on "Endless mode", or try to beat the Challenging "Gauntlet Mode". [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/25e49c4dbef033717c3728ed8399406453c4c902.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/03fecf451234349baa051867b02bbb09ce77f487.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/1263a6b8b3474eb5e32de02d6ba881fc77317fb7.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/67b0470ca9d8c12fe1f792a2890e6143ea0c9d10.png"]Over ten years ago, I made my first game. Although its original files are lost to time, its memory survives. Waddles Land is a re-imagining of that game, adding improved fighting, boss battles, and shops, without sacrificing the challenge, platforming, and charm of the original!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/341c7df73a955ab1bf5370931a07f77034d2fb61.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/1fe0697d0b35eab7c0f1b20494cf5527158b4f00.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/49c03c963e79073d1fb4d4b467c1b47ed6e22a1f.png"]DEV NOTES:  Thanks to everyone who read this far. Thank you all for the support, you've been amazing!  I also want to say, this update took longer than I planned and went a little off track.   I want to make sure that future updates focus more on expanding the general replayability and features of Kollectomaniac.  Next update plans to do just that, and the update after that! -Akmac

notes.title: Kollectomaniac 2.1.7 | Soup, Games, and Agriculture | Part 1
notes.content:
The Agriculture update is here!
Bugs Patched

 Dlarlnod's Log will now display 100% when completed
 You can now get the "Master Logging" Achievement at 100%
 Arm Size Fixed
 Fast Unbox Click Fixed
 Fixed Boots Not Being Interactive at Too Many Worms


Small Changes

 Clock Chime now has a soundwave image
 You can now get the Meet the Walker Achievements unlockable in The Grove
 Summon Rain now only costs Five Cents
 Rain is slightly more common


Major Changes & Features

 You can now plant Acorns, Crows, Pinto, Rice & Yellow Stalk Teeth
 New Item: "Small Umbrella", which protects your incense from the rain!
 New Stat Tracker: "Stat Tracker Add-On 6", displays stock for the displayed item


Scrapped Features
I decided to eliminate the pestering system. I'm concerned it may confuse new players regarding item prices, so I opted not to include it. I might revisit this feature in a future update or consider a variation of it.

I want to thank Dumbazz for the idea of "The Small Umbrella."

Thank you to everyone for the support. The second part of this update, "Soup & Games," is in progress!

-Akmac

notes.title: What's Next for Kollectomaniac?
notes.content:
The next major update, "Soup, Games & Agriculture" is coming soon!
This update won't be as large as the last but will still bring new mechanics and fun games!
It will also come out as a two-part update. Let's go over what will be added...

Part One Agriculture
This update will add all sorts of new plants!
Instead of just planting Death caps, you can grow all sorts of things from Yellow Stalk Teeth to Rice. The strategies are endless!

This first part will also include some new items in the shop:
"The Tiny Umbrella": Ever wished you could light incense in the rain? 
The Tiny Umbrella will let you keep your incense safe from any harmful rain!

"Stat Tracker Add-On 6": Hate checking your stock list? Stat Tracker Add-On 6 will make sure you always know how much you have of the item you're selling! 

And a bonus feature:
"Pestering": If you spam an offer, some Walkers might fold and take a slightly lower offer!

Part Two Soup and Games
Brewing up some tasty soup in The Grove! 
Using items to make all sorts of soup, you're sure to attract some hungry Walkers!
After making soup, walkers will show up to eat it in return for a gift, These gifts may include potions, game consoles, game cartridges, and other strange items!

Stay tuned for future updates!
-Akmacdondon

notes.title: The Murder, Greed & Computers Update
notes.content:
New Content

- Two new items have been added to the shop: Police Tape and The Gun
     The Police Tape creates a new way to limit walkers' options, and the dangerous Nine Round 
     Revolver allows you to shoot birds, shopkeepers, and even Walkers...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/c94c83da9933d290e28fe1593d0d82cc16e681dc.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/834cb4694bcc4715aab2186c7a60a9f87192402b.gif
- The shop now has a small chance to be on sale.

- There's now a new weather type: "Crows".

- A new guide book has been added: "Dlarlnod's Log of Log Survival", which helps new players 
     learn the game's mechanics by showing information as you progress! Unlike save files, this 
     book's progress is unaffected by permadeath and will gather statistics from all your runs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/9e9438e2524f0cbfa17fd3697ca83839017fbecb.gif
- After each day, there's now an alternative to the shop, "The Grove". Instead of buying items to 
     improve your store, The Grove lets players kollect items in the forest, unlock new areas,  
     solve puzzle boxes, gamble your hard-earned cents, and even sell your organs... 
     The Grove also teases at some upcoming features.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/ac7e3c1ffe9ca0cff64a65b4a628755f9b9abf70.gif
- The hidden "A Computer Game" text adventure game has gotten a large room update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/629bfde5d0bc8d6035ce3e383e661751aea0d4c4.gif
- There's now a new death screen for when you die. 

- Twenty new achievements have been added.

- Rain has been added to the Shop.

Quality of Life Changes
- You can now right-click the display stand and cent slab to go backwards. 

- By pressing escape, you can access a pause menu during the game, which includes audio 
     settings, dark mode, stat tracker beep, and more.

- More visible sprite changes have been added for the shop exit menu and day summary screen.

- [strike]A new speedrun timer is accessible in the main menu options.[/strike]

- Older save files will be fully compatible with this new update. 

- Fullscreen is now the default setting.

Bugs Patched
- You can no longer get robbed with only one item.
- Save files loading incorrect walker stats.
- Save files not resetting properly.
- Empty files are not fully resetting.
- Achievement "That's One Happy Worm" wasn't obtainable.
- Achievement "Piano Fan" is now replaced by "I left them...".
- Displaying the purse item breaks the game.
- Certain Items are not showing up in the display stand.
- Items in the shop are blank.
- Tip bowl glitching out cent count.
- Robbed item size fixed.
- Display Stand showing out-of-stock items.
- Coin Furnace Now Stays Burnt after reloading save files.
- Fullscreen window setting larger than your screen.

notes.title: What's Next for Kollectomaniac?
notes.content:
The next major update: "Murder, Greed & Computers" is in progress!
I want to thank everyone for their ongoing support! 
I'm so happy seeing people playing, enjoying, and pushing my game to its limits! 
I've seen some players make it past day fifty when I thought it would be impossible to make it further than day forty. 
This support has pushed me to keep working and make my best game ever!

So I'm here to announce the next major update!
I can't say when it will be out yet, but I can say what it will contain!
Let me break it down for you.

Murder...
Have you ever been mad at a Walker?
Wanted someone out of the game?
Wanted to limit Walker's options?

This part of the update will include two new shop items & unlock the unused "Danger Box" in the shop.
One of these items is rather... deadly.

Greed...
Shopping is fun but safe.
How about a risky alternative?
Maybe even a little... gambling?

This portion of the update will introduce a small portion of the Exploration system. 
Letting players wander into the woods instead of going to the Shop.
I heard there might be someone deep within the grove...

And Computers?
Choices, Choices Choices...

The last main part is a Major room & interface update to "A Computer Game".
If you can't find the computer game currently, it's probability for the best.


Additional Content: 
This update will also come with some well-needed quality of life, tons of bug fixes & a cross-save goal!
Including A drop-down menu, so you can exit the game at any time.
     +
Dlarlnod's Log of Log Survival. 
A progress book that reveals itself as you play, which you can complete goals through saves.
It's filled with log secrets, info on items, tips & tricks, all save statistics and so much more! 
Filling out the whole book would be quite a challenge.

Stay tuned for future updates!
-Akmacdondon
